items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

ctx.x: Well some of these guys were there. Because I remember thinking wow, what a cool thing. I know Grady Tate was there. Maybe it wasn’t even the Tonight Show band, maybe it was a kind of conglomeration. But there were some major players.
It could be, yeah. Was it Clark Terry?

Clark was there I think, yeah. But at any rate, you’ve had a T.V. experience, the solo album experience, some studio experience. Does it get easier to make a living as a jazz musician? You mentioned this one instance where your income really went up, but that was kind of a non-jazz—.
